name: played-emperor
_note: Session G2 'the played campaign' (DYNAMISM_SPEC.md §7b; November 11, 2026). The campaign a France was PLAYED by hand on a freshly rolled seed, one turn at a time from the board each morning, set down as one script so it replays on any build: Ulm on day one (Mack a prisoner); Charles driven from Franconia and broken in Bohemia; Kutuzov met and beaten three times before Vienna; Bohemia, Tyrol, Carniola and Hungary taken; at loop 10 the peace table — the Kingdom of Hungary demanded UNDER SOULT, the joint table set aside for the separate peace with Austria (London unbeaten: the whole-war table cannot carry), Austria's counter (2,800 gold) accepted at loop 12; a peace with Russia at loop 16 that LICENSES her Finnish design (the Tilsit clause — 'Point Russia elsewhere'); at loop 20 a sponsorship of Prussia's Hanoverian Prize (400 gold a turn); then the Emperor watches Europe to loop 40. Every table act is the client's own click ('@…'); the typed openers are the lines the war panel and the Cabinet send. What it pins (tests/test_session_g2_the_played_campaign.py reads the archived digest): Soult takes the crown with his corps; Vienna recognizes the kingdom by the peace that beat her; Prussia, backed, opens her crisis on Hanover and takes it; Naples, at 'war' from loop 2, asks the Pope and marches on Rome. Run: --turns 40 --settlement decline (the league's turn-4 common peace is refused; every other dial is the script's own).
